spoken_lines.speaker: WIFE
spoken_lines.text: Every month is de same foolishness! Where de rent money?

spoken_lines.speaker: PROTAGONIST
spoken_lines.text: Wuhloss! I better find some money quick!

spoken_lines.speaker: VENDOR
spoken_lines.text: Wuh happen to you, boy? Yuh look like yuh had a rough morning!

spoken_lines.speaker: PROTAGONIST
spoken_lines.text: Man, muh wife call me a wutless vagabond! Tell me carry muh backside and guh find de rent money outside!

spoken_lines.speaker: VENDOR
spoken_lines.text: Cor blen! She really tell you all dat?

spoken_lines.speaker: PROTAGONIST
spoken_lines.text: And kick me clean through de door too!

spoken_lines.speaker: VENDOR
spoken_lines.text: Well, standing up hey en gine pay no rent. Come help me move dis crate. I gine give yuh five dollars.

spoken_lines.speaker: PROTAGONIST
spoken_lines.text: Five dollars?! Man, I gine be sleeping outside till Christmas!

spoken_lines.speaker: VENDOR
spoken_lines.text: Thank you for bringing the crate.
